name: Xiamen Hengkun New Materials Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Xiamen Hengkun New Materials Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells semiconductor materials in China. The company's products include photoresists, such as integrated circuits; discrete semiconductor devices, liquid crystal displays and touch panels, advanced packaging, light-emitting diodes, and MEMS; precursor; formulation chemicals; and special gases.
